arxiv-2409-06714.title: FCDM : A Physics-Guided Bidirectional F requency Aware C onvolution and D iffusion-Based M odel for Sinogram Inpainting
arxiv-2409-06714.creator: Jiaze E, Srutarshi Banerjee, Tekin Bicer, Guannan Wang, Yanfu Zhang, Bin Ren
arxiv-2409-06714.description: Abstract Computed tomography (CT) is widely used in industrial and medical imaging, but sparse-view scanning reduces radiation exposure at the cost of incomplete sinograms and challenging reconstruction. Existing RGB-based inpainting models struggle with severe feature entanglement, while sinogram-specific methods often lack explicit physics constraints. We propose FCDM , a physics-guided, frequency-aware sinogram inpainting framework.

arxiv-2504-05470.title: Thermal-diffusive instabilities in unstretched, planar diffusion flames
arxiv-2504-05470.creator: Etienne Robert, Peter A. Monkewitz
arxiv-2504-05470.description: Abstract The recent development of a novel research burner at EPFL has opened the way for experimental investigations of essentially unstretched planar diffusion flames. In particular, it has become feasible to experimentally validate theoretical models for thermal-diffusive instabilities in idealized one-dimensional diffusion flames.

arxiv-2504-14524.title: Hierarchical Robust PCA for Scalable Data Quality Monitoring in Multi-level Aggregation Pipelines
arxiv-2504-14524.creator: Preetam Kumar Ojha
arxiv-2504-14524.description: Abstract Data quality (DQ) remains a fundamental concern in big data pipelines, especially when aggregations occur at multiple hierarchical levels. Traditional DQ validation rules often fail to scale or generalize across dimensions such as user interactions, sessions, profiles, accounts, and regions.

arxiv-2511-05991.title: Ontology Learning and Knowledge Graph Construction: A Comparison of Approaches and Their Impact on RAG Performance
arxiv-2511-05991.creator: Tiago da Cruz, Bernardo Tavares, Francisco Belo
arxiv-2511-05991.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Tiago da Cruz, Bernardo Tavares, Francisco Belo. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems combine Large Language Models (LLMs) with external knowledge, and their performance depends heavily on how that knowledge is represented. This study investigates how different Knowledge Graph (KG) construction strategies influence RAG performance. We compare a variety of approaches: standard vector-based RAG, GraphRAG, and retrieval over KGs built from ontologies derived either from relational databases or textual corpora.

pmc-10738269.title: DESCRIPTIVE EPIDEMIOLOGY ON THE TRENDS OF SUICIDAL ATTEMPTS AMONG OLDER ADULTS IN KOREA FROM 2007–2020
pmc-10738269.creator: Seoyoon Lee, Hyung Eun Shin, SeungCheor Lee, In-Hwan Oh
pmc-10738269.description: When a suicide attempt results in the act of suicide, personal and social losses increase to a degree that is difficult to quantify. It is urgent to evaluate the status of suicide attempts in Korea accurately. This study is to examine a 14-year time series of older adults who have engaged in suicidal behavior or attempted suicide.

pmc-10744576.title: Zirconia-Reinforced Lithium Silicate Ceramic in Digital Dentistry: A Comprehensive Literature Review of Our Current Understanding
pmc-10744576.creator: Manuela Manziuc, Andreea Kui, Andrea Chisnoiu, Anca Labuneț, Marius Negucioiu, Ana Ispas, Smaranda Buduru
pmc-10744576.description: Zirconia-reinforced lithium silicate (ZLS) ceramic is a new innovative dental material with unique a chemical composition that is designed to combine harmoniously with the appropriate optical properties of lithium disilicate and the enhanced mechanical strength of zirconia. A thorough understanding of ZLS materials is essential for both clinicians and dental technicians.

pmc-11379649.title: From ownership to custodianship of tumor biopsy tissue in genomic testing: a mixed methods study of patient views
pmc-11379649.creator: Megan C Best, Phyllis Butow, Jacqueline Savard, Ainsley J Newson, Rachel Campbell, Sabina Vatter, Christine E Napier, Nicci Bartley, Katherine Tucker, Mandy L Ballinger, David M Thomas, the PiGeOn Project
pmc-11379649.description: Tumor mutation profiling (MP) is often conducted on tissue from biopsies conducted for clinical purposes (diagnostic tissue). We aimed to explore the views of patients with cancer on who should own tumor biopsy tissue, pay for its storage, and decide on its future use; and determine their attitudes to and predictors of undergoing additional biopsies if required for research purposes.

pmc-13299879.title: Effectiveness of 6-lead consumer-grade ECG monitoring on the detection of newly diagnosed arrhythmias in patients taking proarrhythmic medications: an interim analysis
pmc-13299879.creator: K H Lee, S J Eom, H J Ahn, S H Joo, M O Chang, Y Y Na, H J Seo, Y H Lee, C H Kim
pmc-13299879.description: IntroductionMedications with proarrhythmic potential, such as certain anticancer agents and antiarrhythmics, can induce or exacerbate arrhythmias. Consequently, continuous cardiac monitoring is advisable for patients receiving these drugs. Contemporary consumer-grade handheld electrocardiogram (ECG) monitoring devices now facilitate rhythm detection within a patient's daily environment.

pmc-13336093.title: Quantifying Magnetic Anisotropy of Ferroelectric Fe(II) Square‐Pyramidal Systems Using Torque Magnetometry
pmc-13336093.creator: Vijaya Thangaraj, Gemma K. Gransbury, Deepanshu Chauhan, Dipanti Borah, Gopalan Rajaraman, Mauro Perfetti, Maheswaran Shanmugam
pmc-13336093.description: The design of mononuclear complexes that simultaneously exhibit multiple functionalities represents a rapidly advancing frontier in molecular materials research. Achieving strong easy‐axis magnetic anisotropy within inherently polar crystal lattices remains a significant challenge, yet it offers a promising pathway toward next‐generation spin–electric materials.

pmc-13415994.title: Efgartigimod in the treatment of immune checkpoint inhibitor-related myasthenia gravis -myositis overlap syndrome: a case report
pmc-13415994.creator: Ke Li, Juanjuan Hu, Zhiji Gan, Jiao Chen, Ye Tian, Ruiqing Luo, Xueliang Qi
pmc-13415994.description: BackgroundA subset of cancer patients receiving monoclonal antibody PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors may develop immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI)-related neurological complications, such as ICI-related myasthenia gravis(MG)-myositis overlap syndrome and ICI-related myocarditis. Standard management typically involves intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIG), plasma exchange (PE), and high-dose corticosteroids.

pmc-13439170.title: A ferroelectric-ionic-trapping transistor for low power and secure neuromorphic computing
pmc-13439170.creator: Changhyeon Han, Youngchan Cho, Dongbin Kim, Se-Hyun Hwang, Minsuk Song, Been Kwak, David Radermacher, Min Wook Kang, Sangwan Kim, Jangsaeng Kim, Wonjun Shin, Daewoong Kwon
pmc-13439170.description: The convergence of artificial intelligence and pervasive data analytics has created an urgent demand for energy-efficient and secure computing hardware. Neuromorphic synaptic devices emulate the human brain with high parallelism and 3D connectivity to reduce power consumption, yet they lack intrinsic mechanisms to protect stored information from malicious read-out.

pmc-13553120.title: Arabidopsis STN7/STN8 alleviates oxidative damages via different regulatory patterns under drought stress
pmc-13553120.creator: Hao‐Tian Mao, Ying Qin, Lun‐Xing Chen, Yi‐Cheng Zhang, Fu‐Yun Wang, Shu Yuan, Shozeb Haider, Yang‐Er Chen
pmc-13553120.description: SUMMARYSTN7 and STN8 kinases phosphorylate several proteins of the photosynthetic apparatus in response to changes in environmental conditions. Phosphorylation is linked to the dynamic arrangement of both the 3D structure of the thylakoid membrane and thylakoid protein complexes, thereby controlling excitation energy transfer between photosystems and the repair cycle of photosystem II (PSII).

pmc-13556471.title: 791. From Preclinical Evidence to Clinical Innovation: NanoBEO as first-in-class novel therapeutic for Neuropsychiatric symptoms and Pain in Severe Dementia
pmc-13556471.creator: D Scuteri, M Contrada, K Hamamura, T Hayashi, P Nicotera, L A Morrone, M T Corasaniti, G Bagetta
pmc-13556471.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundDementia currently affects some 57.4 million people worldwide and approximately 99% of patients with Alzheimer’s Disease (AD) exhibit neuropsychiatric symptoms (NPS). Agitation is a particularly resistant clinical burden characterized by verbal and physical aggression that compromises safety. Authorized treatments are limited to the dopamine D2 receptor antagonist risperidone and the dopamine D2 receptor partial agonist brexpiprazole; however, their use is restricted to 6–12 weeks due to significant cardio-cerebrovascular risks and increased mortality.

pmc-13591283.title: Identification and catalytic optimization of pinene oxidases in paeoniflorin biosynthetic pathway
pmc-13591283.creator: Xi-Rui Tan, Xin-Ran Chen, Long-Ji Wang, Tian-Lin Pei, Jiewei Zhu, Wen-Lu Cai, San-Ming Zhu, Zhong-Rong Yan, Yu Kong, Ying Zhang, Qing Zhao, Xiao-Ya Chen, Jian-Xu Li, Shui-Yan Yu, Yong-Hong Hu
pmc-13591283.description: Paeoniflorin is a pharmacologically important cage-like monoterpene glycoside characteristic of Paeonia plants, yet its biosynthetic pathway has remained largely unresolved, hindering sustainable production. Here, we confirmed that paeoniflorin biosynthesis originates from α-pinene and identified 3 novel cytochrome P450 enzymes that catalyze pinene oxidation.

pmc-13613727.title: Neonatal and maternal outcomes following transfer of vitrified embryos compared with slow-frozen and fresh embryos: a retrospective study in singletons
pmc-13613727.creator: Yue Ying, Jianpeng Chen, Yun Huang, Xilin Shen, YiFeng Lin, Dan Zhang
pmc-13613727.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). PurposeEmbryo cryopreservation plays an essential role in assisted reproductive technology (ART). Vitrification has gradually replaced slow-freezing of embryos. In this study we investigated the effects of embryo vitrification on neonatal and maternal health.MethodsThe retrospective study involved 19,752 in vitro fertilization (IVF) or intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) cycles performed at the Reproductive Medicine Center in Women’s Hospital, School of Medicine, Zhejiang University between October 2014 and September 2019.
